title: Redacción: un técnico (he)
prompt: Write a short composition (60–80 words) in English about an IT technician or network administrator you know or study with (use 3rd person: he / she).
bullets: Personal information and their studies or job role (mention at least one official IT module, e.g., Network Operating Systems, Computer Safety).
The hardware devices or network tools they prefer using daily.
At least ONE comparative (e.g., more secure than) and ONE superlative (e.g., the fastest).

must.label: Menciona un módulo oficial
must.pattern: (assembly and maintenance|operating systems|office automation|local networks|computer safety|network services|web applications|professional training)

forbid.msg: Escribe sobre otra persona: he / she, no 'I'.

model: Karim is 20 years old and he is from Madrid. He studies Microcomputer Systems and Networks. His favourite module is Network Operating Systems because he learns a lot. Every day he uses his laptop, which is faster than his old desktop computer. He also uses a network cable because it is more reliable than Wi-Fi. For Karim, the most interesting part of the job is fixing network problems. He wants to work as a network technician in the future.

title: Diálogo: recepción y hora (Modelo A)
prompt: You are working at the Reception / Front Desk. A candidate arrives for a job interview with the Talent Acquisition team. Time to say: 10:45 (now) and 11:15 (interview).
bullets: Write a short dialogue (8–10 lines) between You and the other person.
Include polite greetings and 3 formal questions asking for personal information.
Include the other person's answers.
Include the person asking for the current time, and you telling the exact time (in words) and the time of the appointment (in words).

must.label: Fórmulas formales (could you / may I / would you / please)
Dice la hora «a quarter to eleven» en palabras
Dice la hora «a quarter past eleven» en palabras
La hora va en palabras, no en cifras (10:45)

model:
Receptionist: Good morning. Welcome to our company.
Candidate: Good morning. I have an interview today.
Receptionist: Could you tell me your full name, please?
Candidate: Yes, my name is Carlos Mora.
Receptionist: What is your contact number?
Candidate: It is 612 345 678.
Receptionist: Which modules did you study?
Candidate: I studied Local Networks and Computer Safety. Excuse me, what time is it?
Receptionist: It is a quarter to eleven. The interview starts at a quarter past eleven.
Candidate: Thank you very much.

title: Diálogo: prácticas y hora (Modelo B)
prompt: You are in the Human Resources Department. A new intern arrives to sign the On The Job Training agreement. Time to say: 9:35 (now) and 10:00 (orientation).
bullets: Write a short dialogue (8–10 lines) between You and the other person.
Include polite greetings and 3 formal questions asking for personal information.
Include the other person's answers.
Include the person asking for the current time, and you telling the exact time (in words) and the time of the appointment (in words).

must.label: Fórmulas formales (could you / may I / would you / please)
Dice la hora «twenty-five to ten» en palabras
Dice la hora «ten o'clock» en palabras
La hora va en palabras, no en cifras (10:45)

model:
HR: Good morning. Are you the new intern?
Intern: Good morning. Yes, I am.
HR: May I have your full name, please?
Intern: My name is Lucía Ortega.
HR: What is your current address?
Intern: I live at 12 Green Street, Madrid.
HR: Could you give me your phone number?
Intern: Yes, it is 600 123 456. Sorry, what time is it?
HR: It is twenty-five to ten. The orientation session begins at ten o'clock.
Intern: Great, thank you.

model:

Client: Good afternoon. I have an appointment with the Accountant.
Receptionist: Could you tell me your full name, please?

title: Direcciones: de la cocina a Ventas (Modelo A)
prompt: A client is in the Kitchenette / Break Room on the Ground Floor and needs to go to the Sales Department on the First Floor.
plan: Plano (según los textos de la profesora): PLANTA BAJA: Main Entrance, Reception/Lobby, Main Corridor (el ascensor/lift está a la izquierda), Kitchenette, Toilets, Boardroom (por el pasillo, a la derecha, enfrente de la Open-Plan Office). PRIMERA PLANTA: al salir del ascensor, a la derecha está la Break Area; después HR Department, IT Office (a la derecha, junto a los restrooms), Archive/Filing Room, Sales Department (entre Archive y HR, enfrente de la Meeting Room), Executive Office al fondo.
bullets: Part A: Write 2 different formal questions asking for directions.
Part B: Write the step-by-step instructions. Use connectors: First, then, turn left/right, go down/up, walk straight, on your left/right, next to, opposite.

parts.label: Part A – 2 formal questions

must.label: Fórmula formal (could you / would you mind / excuse me)

parts.model:
Excuse me, could you tell me how to get to the Sales Department?
Would you mind telling me where the Sales Department is?

parts.label: Part B – step-by-step directions

must.label: Usa on your left / on your right
Menciona la planta (ground / first floor, up / down)

parts.model: First, exit the kitchenette into the main corridor and turn right. Then take the stairs or the lift up to the first floor. When you exit, turn right into the break area. Walk straight ahead past the HR Department. The Sales Department is on your right, between the archive room and the HR Department, opposite the meeting room.

title: Email: solicitar un puesto de técnico
prompt: Write a formal email (50–90 words) to apply for the position of IT technician. Use formal language.
bullets: Start with Dear + name and say why you are writing.
Give personal information and your studies.
Mention your experience or skills.
Say that your CV is attached and close the email politely.

must.label: Dice por qué escribe (I am writing to…)
must.pattern: i am writing to|i would like to apply

must.label: Menciona el CV adjunto (Please find attached…)
Cierre formal (Yours sincerely / faithfully / I look forward…)
Menciona tus estudios o un módulo

model:
Dear Mrs Brown,

I am writing to apply for the position of IT technician. I am 20 years old and I study Microcomputer Systems and Networks. I have experience in installing computers and changing network cables. I can work in a team and I learn fast. Please find attached my CV. I look forward to hearing from you.

Yours sincerely,
Nour Eddin
